datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (monthly) field assessments and compiled Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) data for Central African Republic in 2021. Geographic data were classified into IPC scenarios and distributed as monthly snapshots in GeoJSON and KML formats, representing spatial projections of acute food insecurity phases across administrative units.
